title: Simply Recipes
description: A recipe editor/loader mod for Minecraft version 26.1+.
body:
## **<center><font color="cyan">Simply Recipes!</font></center>**

This is a Beta release for a GUI based recipe editor/item creator that I have been working on for Minecraft 26.1+. Recipe changes are updated in real time, no need to type /reload or restart the game. Please report any bugs in the Issue Tracker.

## **<center><font color="cyan">Demo!</font></center>**

**<center>![Simply Recipes Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06b8c0404eb400f58227a2eaa30ea3d54ccb9af8.gif)</center>**

## **<center><font color="cyan">How to use:</font></center>**

The default key-bind to open the recipe editor is K. This will bring up the recipe creator window.

![Recipe Editor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32b35d032ef61d76a28da042203c7bd373b01b87.png)

## **<center><font color="cyan">Select from a range of different crafting types:</font></center>**
